strategy_reason: Multiple Level 2 reasoning records express distinct decision patterns, but they are thematically diverse and lack a unifying, recurring logic across domains. While several records show cautious, condition-based reasoning (e.g., trade-offs in investment, personal behavior, platform governance), no single decision framework recurs with sufficient frequency or structural similarity to justify principle_extraction. The patterns are related in tone (risk-aware, evidence-conditioned) but not in mechanism. Thus, a light grouping of cautious, context-bound provisional principles is appropriate.

principles.name: Prefer cost-effective AI infrastructure if it enables new use cases despite durability risks
principles.decision_context: Evaluating semiconductor and storage companies benefiting from on-premise AI inference and fine-tuning.
principles.core_preference: Favor solutions that reduce total cost of ownership (TCO) for AI deployment, especially when they unlock previously inaccessible markets.
reasoning_steps: High-cost components (e.g., HBM) limit AI adoption to large enterprises.
NAND Flash offers a cheaper alternative for caching AI model weights.
Software-layer optimization can redirect partial workloads to SSDs.
Lower entry cost enables SMBs to join AI adoption wave.
preferred_actions: Monitor OEM/ODM adoption of Phison's Adaptive solution at Computex.
Evaluate NAND Flash suppliers positioned to benefit from increased on-device inference.
conditions: SSD endurance must support 100 writes/day for 5 years.
Open-source AI models continue to improve in usability and performance.

decision_tradeoff.option_a: Adopt high-performance, high-cost AI hardware (e.g., HBM-based GPUs)
decision_tradeoff.option_b: Adopt cost-optimized AI hardware using NAND Flash caching
decision_tradeoff.reason_for_preference: Enables AI deployment in SMBs and edge environments previously excluded by cost.
decision_tradeoff.cost_of_preference: Increased wear on SSDs; potential reliability issues under heavy write load.
switch_conditions: If open-source models fail to gain enterprise traction

distinctive_behavior: Uses firsthand visit observations to validate technical claims
Frames infrastructure demand through application-level bottlenecks (e.g., storage)
eligibility_reasons: Episode-local principle may be used only as assisted context, not a confirmed policy.
principles.evidence_summary: Based on Phison visit and analysis of AI storage demand. Two reasoning records (001, 002) support cost-driven infrastructure enablement, but both are forward-looking with stated uncertainties about market adoption and durability. No contradictory views in episode, but evidence is narrow to one company and one technical approach.

Self-awareness allows for proactive behavioral compensation.
Medication is not required if individual can function with adjustments.

principles.name: Resist subjective speech suppression; defend platform moderation based on criminal conviction

principles.core_preference: Platforms should not deplatform users for offensive speech absent criminal conduct.

conditions: Speech does not constitute direct incitement or illegal coordination.
